Job documentation - AI tools for contractors

Site photos, daily reports, progress tracking and proof of work for clients and compliance.

Why this matters Without photo records, disputes over what was done become your word against theirs.

What Job documentation actually involves

Photographs end arguments. Before-and-after records, daily progress reports and signed sign-offs are what protect you when a customer disputes what was done, and on electrical and gas work the paperwork is legally required regardless. The tools here make capturing that record automatic rather than something you remember at the end of the day.

Frequently asked questions

Which job documentation tools are worth trying first?

The three that stand out here are Knowify (Contractors who need to know whether a job actually made money), Contractor Foreman (Small contractors who want one system instead of five spreadsheets), CompanyCam (Any trade that needs proof of what was done and when). Start with the one that matches your size and the work you do most, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does job documentation software cost?

Across the 10 tools on this page, 4 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices move often, so confirm on the vendor site before committing.

Can I try these tools for free?

Yes 鈥?ChatGPT, Claude, Otter.ai, Loom all have a free tier, so you can run a few real jobs through them before paying anything.

How long should I keep job photos?

For as long as the warranty on your work runs, and longer for anything involving compliance certificates. Storage is cheap; a missing photo during a dispute is expensive.
